title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #079 · 교복 · 마이크로 비키니 탑 × 타이트 마이크로 펜슬+지퍼 슬릿 · 극단 플랫폼 핑크 스니커즈 · 세로 줄 홈 · violin hip hourglass · 정면 한 손 허리 · 배경 아테네 파르테논 · 야미카와
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a micro bikini top of two tiny triangle cups of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with thin navy piping, held by thin navy strings tied behind her neck and back, with a small gold crest bead between the cups, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a skin-tight micro pencil mini skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-blue modal jersey sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones, a front zipper slit pulled from the hem up to her hip bone. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the pencil mini skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing facing the camera straight on, one hand resting on her waist and the other hand relaxed at her side, her legs fully in view — most extreme violin hip hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: platform shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pastel pink leather sneakers with white laces, each built on a towering solid white rubber platform sole taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee, its tall side wall decorated with evenly spaced deep vertical grooves sculpted into the cushioned midsole all around the side wall like a ribbed cushion, worn with white ankle socks with a ruffle trim, her feet held level on the flat tops of the platforms, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: the ancient Parthenon terrace on the Acropolis in Athens, pale weathered marble paving, fluted columns and standard-height stone steps, empty of tourists, in warm golden late-afternoon light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
